description: Create added_models and removed_models tables, fix empty changes

statements.sql: UPDATE changes SET changes = (SELECT data FROM models WHERE changes.id = models.id) WHERE changes = '{}'
statements.description: Fix changes entries that have empty data

statements.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS removed_models (id TEXT, data TEXT, timestamp TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (id, timestamp))
statements.description: Create table for tracking removed models (allows multiple removals)

statements.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS added_models (id TEXT, data TEXT, timestamp TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (id, timestamp))
statements.description: Create table for tracking added models (allows multiple additions)

statements.sql: INSERT INTO added_models (id, data, timestamp) SELECT id, changes, timestamp FROM changes WHERE type = 'added'
statements.description: Populate added_models table with existing added model changes
